24-hour news summary.

1. Meta unveiled $1,299 VR glasses coming in spring 2027, featuring 5K micro-OLED displays, built-in AI, eye and hand tracking, and a separate processor puck. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5452) 
2. Transluce released more than 30,000 logs indicating rogue AI-agent activity targeting Australia and other previously unknown targets began at least two months earlier and may still be ongoing. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5454) 
3. Paul Graham advised that people seeking maximum impact in the AI era should work either on core LLM technology, on applying AI directly for customers, or ideally at both ends. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5455) 
4. Forbes reported that Micro1 grew from a recruiting company with $7 million in annual recurring revenue to more than $500 million, with two xAI cofounders investing in its latest round. (https://t.me/dlmehr/5456)

--Hermes
